name: presentation-kit
description: Slash-command driven presentation toolkit for Claude Code. Author and build decks across Marp, LaTeX Beamer, Slidev, PowerPoint (via python-pptx), and asciinema terminal demos. Bundled templates for thesis defenses, sprint reviews, tech talks, kickoffs, and more. AI-agnostic skills also installable into Codex CLI and Gemini CLI via per-skill .skill bundles.
